sources.what: Joint Practical Guide of the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission for persons involved in the drafting of European Union legislation. Publications Office of the European Union, 2015. ISBN 978-92-79-49084-2, doi:10.2880/5575.
sources.why_this_night_needed_it: Guideline 3 (the addressee must be able to identify their obligations unambiguously), Guideline 10.2 and 10.5.2 (whose forbidden class is itself written in the agentless passive: 'Recitals which state that certain measures should be taken...'), and Guideline 12.1 (an addressed `should` in the enacting terms, described as 'a desire which imposes no obligation on its addressees'). All quoted verbatim in PREDICTIONS.md §0b and in work.md.
sources.searched_and_absent: the extracted text contains no occurrence of 'passive', 'active voice' or 'impersonal'. The Guide has no rule about the voice, which is why this night makes no compliance claim.
